alternatives.name: OpenBao
alternatives.why_not_default: The foundation decision explicitly records OpenBao as unused and unqualified. Its referenced adoption manifest specifies native login on the target but contains no OpenBao qualification. No retained installed secret-storage, retrieval, rotation or revocation comparison establishes an advantage.

limits: Reviewed retained evidence only; did not execute scans or verify the current host's authentication state.
The later history-scan results were read from configuration commentary, not independently replayed.
Upstream metadata was supplied by the packet and was not independently refreshed.
open_gaps: Gitleaks detects exposure; the evidence does not establish enforcement that all native sign-ins and credentials remain outside the checkout.
Synthetic detection controls do not establish detection of every credential format or absence of secrets.
The configuration records clean branch-ancestry and working-tree scans but a residual synthetic finding on another branch in the default all-refs scan.
The configured size limit excludes oversized generated explorer HTML.
No operational OpenBao comparison or multi-host credential lifecycle acceptance is retained.
The broker credential environment variables belong to the separate trading gate.

arms: Current gitleaks configuration: planted credential controls inside and outside reviewed allowlist paths.
Current gitleaks configuration: legitimate digest and pagination controls.
Current gitleaks configuration: branch-ancestry scan and report-versus-exit-code consistency.
overturn_protocol.metric: Require credential controls to be detected, legitimate controls to remain suppressed, a valid completed ancestry scan to report zero findings, and findings to remain observable despite a forced zero exit code. Missing reports, executable failures and skipped tests do not establish acceptance.

overturn_when: Reconsider the default if python3 -m unittest -v tests.test_gitleaks_config produces a confirmed missed credential, excessive allowlisting, false-positive control failure or branch-ancestry exposure. Inspect actual reports and successful scanner completion; skips and exit code zero alone are insufficient. Promotion of OpenBao additionally requires an executed operational comparison, which is not currently retained.
why_selected: Select gitleaks for the exposure-detection portion of the requirement. Retained native execution in blueprints/convergence-practice/wsl-native-tools/receipt-wsl-hardened.json records gitleaks 8.30.1 detecting one inert credential, accepting the clean control with zero findings, and producing fully redacted reports. This is bounded native execution on synthetic inputs. adoption/manifest.json supplies the complementary native-login-on-target policy; that policy is source-reviewed, not demonstrated credential-isolation enforcement. Project-local allowlist checks in tests/test_gitleaks_config.py address accidental suppression but were not executed in this review.
